children: Pemex is performing routine maintenance on multiple units at its 312,500-barrel-per-day Deer Park, Texas, refinery, people familiar with plant operations said.

Pemex filed notices through September informing nearby residents of possible use of the safety flare system due to “work activities.” The flares, which are used to burn off hydrocarbons that cannot be processed normally, generate noise and thick black smoke.
